description: This file contains shell functions for upgrading and preparing the Zyxel device, including environment checks, MTD partition handling, and reboot logic.

methods.name: zyxel_mstc_prepare_fail
methods.description: Handles failure by rebooting the device after unmounting all filesystems.

methods.name: zyxel_mstc_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the device for upgrade by checking partitions, retrieving boot number, and setting environment variables.

calls: dd of=${persist_mtd} count=1 bs=1 seek=4 conv=notrunc
